trap-em-dash.evidence: Seven em-dashes in 237 words — 30 per 1000, the highest density in this batch by a factor of three. Four are load-bearing (the appositive 'any element — in particular log Phi_b'; the two bullet glosses '— the hyperbolic volume / mass face' and '— the Chern-Simons / decay face'), but the run in the opening paragraph ('... which the compact form also has') and the trailing '— so the ladder element factors as F = F_even * F_odd' both append a clause where a full stop belongs, and the last of those carries the section's conclusion.

trap-superlative.notes: RIGOR — three items. (1) VERIFIED CORRECT AND CURRENT: 'c_3 (bar-odd) swings approx 2.375% between the proton and muon anchors'. AGENTS.md's 2026-08-16 correction gives the measured cross-anchor swing as 2.3748% proton-normalised, which rounds to exactly 2.375. This block is one of the few carrying the CURRENT figure rather than the superseded 'approx 3%' (which traces to a pre-#1422 c_3 = -2.0097); do not 'fix' it. Also correct: the epistemic hygiene line 'The mathematical statement ... is unconditional; only this physical identification ... invokes the conjecture', and the modular-double-vs-bar disambiguation. (2) UNDER-SPECIFIED CLAIM flagged by name in AGENTS.md: 'c_2 = -1 (bar-even) is Taylor-exact'. Per the 2026-08-16 ruling, 'Taylor' here is under-specified rather than false — c_2 = -1 IS the u^2 coefficient of the explicit-factor product prod_{k>=2}(1 + c_k u^k), but the full normalised model Phi(u)/Phi(0) has c-tilde_2 = c_2 - 1/8 = -9/8. The ruling's instruction is to say WHICH SERIES, never to delete the word. Proposed: 'c_2 = -1 (bar-even) is the exact u^2 coefficient of the explicit-factor product'. (3) CONVENTION LABEL MISSING: the owner ruling of 2026-08-15 makes convention D canonical and excises C, and the entire c_k ladder — c_2 = -1, c_3, and the cross-anchor swing — is convention-C-frame and has NOT been re-derived under D (bean qou-cds1). This block's '## Consequence for the c_k ladder' section states a general law (bar-parity predicts anchor-behaviour) from those rungs with no C-conditional label. Proposed: label the section C-conditional. SECONDARY, epistemic: 'This is confirmed on both available rungs' rests on n = 2, and one of the two is not independent evidence — c_2 = -1 is claimed structural (no fit, no CODATA, no q_0), so its anchor-stability follows by construction rather than confirming the parity law. The honest reading is one informative rung.
